# Dictionary sample data: separate license

The `*.jsonl` files here contain small, real **field projections** of Kaikki.org
per-word Wiktextract JSONL downloads. They are not synthetic lexical entries or
untouched raw-dump rows. The original response/line SHA256 and projection SHA256
are recorded in `SOURCES.json`; the extraction snapshot is 2026-10-25 from the
2026-10-01 English Wiktionary dump.

Dictionary text is attributed to **Wiktionary contributors**, extracted and
published by **Tatu Ylonen and Wiktextract contributors through Kaikki.org**.
Each language metadata file and `SOURCES.json` retain the source entries, author
history links, retrieval URLs and revision. These derivative data files are
distributed under **Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International**:
<https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/>.

The English Wiktionary copyright policy documents CC BY-SA 4.0/GFDL text and
warns that third-party quotations/media can have separate rights:
<https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Wiktionary:Copyrights>. For these redistributable
samples **all examples and quotations, audio/media URLs, etymology and unrelated
fields were removed**. Kept data: headword/language/part of speech, recorded
forms, written pronunciations, and sense glosses/tags/form-of links. Missing
examples are not generated or silently reconstructed.

This data license is distinct from the LingoBar application code's CC BY-NC 4.0
license. The MIT license of the Wiktextract extraction software does **not**
license the dictionary data. No extractor code is copied or executed here.

The samples contain only a few common headwords per language. They are not
full dictionaries, eight complete downloadable language editions, a Chinese
gloss package, or a measured vocabulary-coverage claim.
